measurement_notes: wait4 user/system is leader-attributed usage; may include descendants it waited for
sampled tree CPU sums maximum observed ps self CPU per PID/birth; lower bound only
wait4 and sampled tree CPU overlap and are not additive; no complete-tree CPU savings claim
ps CPU resolution and lstart second resolution can miss work or rapid PID reuse
short-lived children, escaped descendants, and CPU during cleanup may be missed by sampling
outer wall includes launch, monitoring and cleanup; excludes initial metadata and final report writes
stage attribution, ledger checks and sampler/runner CPU are not provided by this wrapper
RSS from ps KiB converted to bytes; sum of live owned tree; not heap allocation
storage is positive logical file-size growth per supplied root; excludes deleted-file peak between samples
limits sampled; short spikes and daemonized ancestry escape between samples may be missed
samples exclude runner/ps RSS; storage report written after the measured command
child stdout/stderr/argv retained only in protected output
